# Publish gate report

**Going out:** Product page copy for the Chamomile and Lemon Balm blend, UK audience. No schedule given.

**Checks**
- **Claims:** all pass.

| Claim | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Certified organic by the Soil Association | On policy list | "certified organic by the Soil Association" |
| 20 plastic-free tea bags | On policy list | "tea bags are plastic-free", and pack size is a product fact |
| Caffeine-free | Product fact (ingredients) | Allowed as written. Both herbs are naturally caffeine-free. |
| Gentle, honeyed, for the evening | Flavour and occasion description | Allowed as written |

- **Regulated claims:** pass. The copy makes no claim about sleep, relaxation, calming or other health effects, and "gentle" describes the taste. The plastic-free claim is specific and matches the policy, so it isn't a broad green claim. It also doesn't say "compostable", which the policy supports but the copy doesn't need.
- **House style:** the copy has no stock openers, intensifiers, tidy triplets or slogan closers. The policy gives no voice section to score against, so I judged it on plain, specific wording only.
- **Disclosure:** this is the brand's own product page, with no ad, sponsorship, affiliate link, gifted product or AI-label trigger, so no label is needed.

**Fixed:** nothing needed changing.

**Needs a decision:** none on content. If you add sleep or relaxation wording later, it needs a new check.

**Approver:** the policy names no approver, so I need an explicit yes from you (the user) on this exact text. Once you've given it, record it with `approve.py --by "Your Name"` before publishing. I haven't recorded any approval.

```json
{"issues": [], "publish": true}
```
